title: Reduce settings command history WebView flat exports
summary: Reduced the Settings command-history flat WebView export surface by removing duplicate flat aliases from settingsCommandHistory.js and settingsView.js while preserving namespace access.
reason: Continue the WebView flat-export cleanup workstream with a narrow Settings-domain slice that keeps namespace-first access and avoids backend or mutation-policy changes.
behavior_before: Settings command-history helpers were available through mediaPipelineSettingsCommandHistory and also as flat window aliases from both settingsCommandHistory.js and settingsView.js.
behavior_after: Settings command-history helpers are consumed through mediaPipelineSettingsCommandHistory; command-history and launch evidence paths call the namespace renderer/helper, and the three duplicate flat aliases are no longer exported from the Settings command-history path.
manual_validation: npm run webview:map; npm run webview:map:check (regenerated then passed)
npm run webview:slices; npm run webview:slices:check (regenerated then passed)
rollback_plan: Restore the removed settings command-history flat window assignments and the previous direct flat-call sites, then regenerate WebView contract/map/slice artifacts and summaries.
notes:
